subject: Novara therapeutic: security-driven deployment options & next steps (post-demo)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kumar <asha.kumar@novaratherapeutics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novara therapeutic: security-driven deployment options & next steps (post-demo)

Hi Asha — thanks again for your time on the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum going: 

Summary from today's call:
- Goal: Novara will surface PHI from clinical notes into a triage assistant; high sensitivity, planned retention in Novara systems.
- Primary concerns: BAA coverage, SOC2 evidence, network isolation, and audit support for annual reviews.
- Preference expressed: procurement team wants clear list of deliverables and timeline before committing to Dedicated or Private VPC.

Deployment options we discussed (short pros/cons):
- Hosted API (Redwood-hosted): fastest onboarding, but requires BAA + SOC2 artifacts and strict data handling controls. Lower infra overhead; supports prefix/KV caching but is multitenant.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool): gives Novara a separated tenant and predictable throughput; supports customer-managed keys and stricter tenancy controls. Easier middle ground for teams that need isolation without full VPC.
- Private VPC / On-prem: full network-level isolation, customer-controlled networking and KMS/HSM — recommended when audits require absence of multi-tenant compute or for strict regulatory controls.

Immediate asks I promised to follow up on:
1) Concrete evidence list (SOC2 Type II report, AICPA bridge letter, BAA template, network diagrams, encryption & KMS details, pen-test summary). See attached PDF "Novara_Security_Questions.pdf" for the questions you shared on the call.
2) Timeline options: we can prepare a security-deep-dive (1 hour) within 5 business days; evidence bundle (redacted SOC2, data flow diagram, certs) within 7-10 business days for initial review.
3) Cost/contract signal: Laura — can you prepare a one-page split showing delta between Hosted / Dedicated / Private (OPEX vs one-time setup, ballpark)? Ben — can you flag required SLA/commitment tiers for Dedicated capacity?

Proposed next steps (if that works for Novara):
- Schedule security deep-dive with Novara SecOps + Redwood Security (45–60 mins).
- Provide initial evidence bundle (redacted SOC2, BAA draft, network diagram).
- Procurement to confirm procurement timeline and any required redlines to BAA.

Asha — what times next week look good for a 45-minute security deep-dive? We can kick off with the evidence bundle beforehand so your team has time to review.

Attachments: DemoRecording_2026-09-17.mp4 (stub), Novara_Security_Questions.pdf

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Novara therapeutic: security-driven deployment options & next steps (post-demo)

Markus — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming that Novara will be sending PHI (clinical notes). That pushes this to a BAA-covered flow; we need explicit confirmation that logs/retention settings can be configured such that Novara data is not retained beyond the allowed window and that Redwood can sign a BAA.
- SOC2: we need the latest SOC2 Type II and a contact to discuss scope (systems included, any exclusions).
- Pen test / vuln scan: do you provide recent pen-test summaries or do we need to arrange a joint assessment?
- Preferred deployment: procurement prefers Dedicated capacity or Private VPC. Hosted is acceptable only if we get strict contractual and technical guarantees (BAA + retention enforcement + network egress controls).

We are targeting a compliance review the week of Oct 4 — ideally we would have your evidence bundle and a security deep-dive by Sep 25. Can you meet that timeline?

—Asha
Head of Security & Compliance
Novara Therapeutics
asha.kumar@novaratherapeutics.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novara therapeutic: security-driven deployment options & next steps (post-demo)

Asha — appreciate the timeline. Quick alignment from Redwood security & sales on what we can provide within your window: 

Evidence bundle (we will assemble and share by Sep 24):
- Redacted SOC2 Type II (most recent) — Redwood_SoC2_Redacted.pdf
- SOC2 bridge letter explaining systems in-scope and any recent changes
- BAA draft tailored for Novara (BAA_Draft_Redwood-Novara.docx)
- Network diagram (high-level) for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC
- Description of KMS options (customer-managed keys in Dedicated + Private; Redwood-managed in Hosted) and HSM allegiances
- Data retention & deletion controls (how to enforce short retention, retention API)
- Pen-test summary (redacted) and statement of available dates for joint assessment if needed

Deployment-specific comments: 
- Hosted: we can sign a BAA. For strict retention enforcement we expose retention controls and a retention-enforcement SLA; logs scoped to what Redwood requires for operation (can be redacted).
- Dedicated capacity: provides tenant-level separation, supports customer KMS, and can be placed into a customer VPC peer (private networking) for tighter egress controls. Typical prep time: 4–6 weeks for reserved capacity + network setup (can be faster with prioritized onboarding).
- Private VPC/On-prem: fully isolated, best for audited environments. Setup time depends on customer infra; typical on-prem engagements are 6–10 weeks plus audit windows.

We will attach the evidence bundle and a one-page cost/commitment overview by EOD Sep 24. Markus — Ben and I will prepare the Dedicated vs Private delta and a shortlist of items procurement commonly requests (paperwork, SOC2 review cycle, standard redlines).

Next call options: Sep 23 (10:00–11:00 PT) or Sep 24 (14:00–15:00 PT) for the security deep-dive. Which works for Novara?

Best,
Laura Bennett
